\section{Systems}
A system of equations:
\begin{align}
  a_1 x + b_1 y &= c_1 \label{eq:first}\\
  a_2 x + b_2 y &= c_2
\end{align}
The solution uses the determinant
\[
  D = \begin{vmatrix} a_1 & b_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 \end{vmatrix} = a_1 b_2 - a_2 b_1 .
\]
Summation and integral: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}$ and
\begin{equation}
  \int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}.
\end{equation}
A piecewise definition:
\begin{equation}
  f(x) = \begin{cases} x^2 & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}
\end{equation}
